_doc: Slide-2 exec-summary / thesis. DISTILLED from the partner proposal; proposal is source of truth.
positioning: the black-car network, on the water
thesis: Southeast Asia's super-app already owns the demand. Water is the only transport surface no one owns yet.
the_deal: We launch a Grab-branded foiling water tier across Southeast Asia's densest coastal and cross-border corridors — booked in-app, premium-priced, region-wide and category-defining.

your_world.label: Where you are today
your_world.text: You are Southeast Asia's everyday super-app — mobility, deliveries, and payments in one.

your_world.label: What you're up against
your_world.text: Ride-hail on land is maturing and increasingly contested.

your_world.label: Where Navier fits
your_world.text: Water is the only transport surface in Southeast Asia no one owns yet.

your_world.label: Why now
your_world.text: Foiling lifts the hull clear — faster, near-silent and far more efficient per seat-mile.
